# December 1938 and December 1940 General Fund balances (Treasury Bulletin, Composition of the General Fund)
# Working balance / Total balance ratio
# Dec 1938: working balance = 1801, total balance = 2756
# Dec 1940: working balance = 2031, total balance = 3088
wb_1938 = 1801.0
tb_1938 = 2756.0
wb_1940 = 2031.0
tb_1940 = 3088.0

ratio_1938 = wb_1938 / tb_1938
ratio_1940 = wb_1940 / tb_1940

# two-year span (Dec 1938 -> Dec 1940)
geo_rate = (ratio_1940 / ratio_1938) ** (1/2) - 1
print(round(geo_rate, 3))
